t: The Fortress Trade 9" Short Pile Emulsion Roller Sleeve delivers a professional, smooth finish for various painting projects. Ensures excellent paint load and even release, significantly reducing splatter and lint loss. Closed fibres contribute to a consistently smooth and even texture across surfaces. Ideal for painting interior walls and ceilings in residential and commercial properties, especially when applying a final top coat to plastered walls, providing reliability and efficiency for decorators and tradespeople working with emulsion paints.
